why_lead: The holiday weekend's outcome is the freshest crowd story: CNBC's record 9.8 billion USD Black Friday online spend, +7.5% (n0144) and Barron's Thanksgiving record (n0673), published after the 2023-11-24 edition's preview-based Amazon item, with Cyber Monday on the edition date (n0149, n0151). Amazon 146.74 USD, +22.72% over 20 sessions; XLY +13.64%, Target +18.57%, Walmart -3.53%. Attention: Black Friday read as a market event (n1484, n0142, n0085); analog is the holiday-extrapolation mechanism anchored on MarketWatch's look back to 1990 (n1484); smart-money split between the scoreboard and on-the-ground caution (n1591, n1736, n1735, n1045); breaks on margins (n1601), labour (n0932) and a stalled five-session move.
why_smaller: Coinbase: newly published 18-month high (n0678) and crypto-FOMO evidence (n0798) with COIN +5.76% (+54.86% over 20 sessions) versus bitcoin +6.97%: an equity-proxy leverage story; the 2023-11-21 Coinbase item preceded the Binance shock, so this is a material update. Valuation, crypto-bro and Lagarde headlines (n0623, n0801, n1013) supply the break.

Silver: +2.78% to 24.33 USD/oz with SLV +2.77% and gold back at 2,003.00 USD/oz on a weaker-dollar, rate-cut narrative (n1021, n0141); the fragile 2,000 USD gold line (n1718) and debt-supply pressure on rates (n0147) supply the break. Precious metals last appeared on 2023-11-01 (gold).
Berkshire Hathaway: the Buffett-copycat crowd around Berkshire's full P&G and UPS exits (n0737, n0712, n0505, n0373); stale-filing and succession risk (n0486) supply the break. New ticker.
